instruction: Set GIMP to fullscreen so the workspace is maximized.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling fullscreen mode in GIMP. The evaluator checks the sessionrc config file for the 'fullscreen' setting being set to 'yes'. Similar difficulty to original - requires using View > Fullscreen or F11 key to enable fullscreen mode.
